articles.title: XPENG to Showcase "Physical AI" Ecosystem at Beijing Auto Show, Outlining Global Vision for Smart Mobility
articles.mainIdea: XPENG to Showcase "Physical AI" Ecosystem at Beijing Auto Show, Outlining Global Vision for Smart Mobility
articles.summary: PR Newswire: XPENG to Showcase "Physical AI" Ecosystem at Beijing Auto Show, Outlining Global Vision for Smart Mobility. XPENG will unveil its next-generation "Physical AI" ecosystem at the Beijing Auto Show starting April 24, showcasing its transition from a smart EV manufacturer to a global leader in physical AI. The presentation will feature a comprehensive portfolio spanning intelligent driving, robotics, and aerial mobility, alongside the latest technical and product updates.

articles.title: XPENG Files 2025 Annual Report on Form 20-F
articles.mainIdea: XPENG Files 2025 Annual Report on Form 20-F
articles.summary: PR Newswire: XPENG Files 2025 Annual Report on Form 20-F. XPeng Inc. ("XPENG" or the "Company," NYSE: XPEV and HKEX: 9868), a leading global AI mobility technology company, today announced that it filed its annual report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC") on April 16, 2026. The annual report can be accessed on XPENG's investor relations website at https://ir.xiaopeng.com.
